articles.title: From cantonment rebellion to state power: Ziaur Rahman’s political rise
articles.description: Freed from house arrest on November 7, 1975, he became president in April 1977. Ziaur Rahman subsequently consolidated his position through rural development initiatives, public engagement and a gradual shift toward electoral politics, culminating in the formation of the BNP in 1978.
